name: AFI Protocol
rootCause: On May 30, 2026, AFI Protocol's afiUSD vault on Ethereum was exploited, resulting in a loss of about $480,000. The attacker drained stablecoin assets, converted DAI to ETH, and routed a substantial portion through Tornado Cash. Investigations are ongoing, but the precise exploit mechanism has not been publicly disclosed. The specific vulnerability exploited remains unconfirmed. No public post-mortem or technical disclosure from AFI has detailed the root cause. Multiple high-severity vulnerabilities were reported to the team before the attack, but which issue enabled the exploit is not established.
